resources.string: This sends Stop to the original gateway. Work already applied is retained, and a running operation may need to reach a safe stopping point.
Stop requested. The gateway has not yet confirmed that the job stopped.
The gateway confirmed that the job stopped.
The job already finished. Its saved result and history are retained.
Stop is unconfirmed. The job may still be running. Check its current status before retrying.
The gateway does not currently allow Stop for this job. Its saved state is retained.
